import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 10000000;
    static final int N = 210;
    static final int M = 21000;
    
    static class Edge {
        int v, w;
        Edge(int v, int w) { this.v = v; this.w = w; }
    }
    
    static Edge[] edge = new Edge[M];
    static int[] adj = new int[M];
    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static int e = 0;
    
    static void addedge(int u, int v, int w) {
        edge[e] = new Edge(v, w);
        adj[e] = head[u];
        head[u] = e++;
        edge[e] = new Edge(u, 0);
        adj[e] = head[v];
        head[v] = e++;
    }
    
    static int S, T;
    static int[] dist = new int[N];
    static int[] q = new int[N * 2];
    static int[] arc = new int[N];
    static int[] gap = new int[N];
    static int[] inq = new int[N];
    static int[] pre = new int[N];
    
    static int SAP(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(arc, -1);
        Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
        int qf = 0, qr = 0;
        q[qr++] = t;
        inq[t] = 1;
        gap[0]++;
        dist[t] = 0;
        
        while (qf < qr) {
            int u = q[qf++];
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = adj[i]) {
                int v = edge[i].v;
                if (inq[v] == 0) {
                    q[qr++] = v;
                    inq[v] = 1;
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    gap[dist[v]]++;
                    arc[v] = head[v];
                }
            }
        }
        
        int low = INF, u = s, ans = 0;
        pre[s] = s;
        while (dist[s] < t) {
            boolean flag = false;
            for (int i = arc[u]; i != -1; i = adj[i]) {
                if (edge[i].w > 0 && dist[edge[i].v] + 1 == dist[u]) {
                    flag = true;
                    low = Math.min(low, edge[i].w);
                    pre[edge[i].v] = u;
                    u = edge[i].v;
                    if (u == t) {
                        while (u != s) {
                            u = pre[u];
                            edge[arc[u]].w -= low;
                            edge[arc[u] ^ 1].w += low;
                        }
                        ans += low;
                        low = INF;
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (flag) continue;
            
            int mindis = t + 1;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = adj[i]) {
                if (edge[i].w > 0 && mindis > dist[edge[i].v]) {
                    mindis = dist[edge[i].v];
                    arc[u] = i;
                }
            }
            gap[dist[u]]--;
            if (gap[dist[u]] == 0) return ans;
            dist[u] = mindis + 1;
            gap[dist[u]]++;
            u = pre[u];
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    static char[][] str = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] str2 = new char[12][12];
    static int[][] sci = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] ca = new int[12][12];
    static int[][][] stone = new int[62][12][12];
    static int[][][][][] dp = new int[62][12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] dir = {{-1, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}};
    static int n, t;
    
    static void expand() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= t; ++k) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                    if (stone[k-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        stone[k][i][j] = 1;
                    } else if (stone[k-1][i][j] == 2) {
                        stone[k][i][j] = 2;
                    } else {
                        int nx, ny;
                        for (int z = 0; z < 4; ++z) {
                            nx = i + dir[z][0];
                            ny = j + dir[z][1];
                            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n) {
                                if (stone[k-1][nx][ny] == 2) {
                                    stone[k][i][j] = 2;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static int[][] vis = new int[12][12];
    
    static void dfs(int x, int y, int nowx, int nowy, int k) {
        vis[nowx][nowy] = 1;
        dp[k][x][y][nowx][nowy] = 1;
        if (k >= t || stone[k][nowx][nowy] != 0) return;
        
        int nx, ny;
        for (int z = 0; z < 4; ++z) {
            nx = nowx + dir[z][0];
            ny = nowy + dir[z][1];
            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && vis[nx][ny] == 0) {
                if (stone[k][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
                dfs(x, y, nx, ny, k + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                str[i][j] = s.charAt(j-1);
                if (str[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    stone[0][i][j] = 2;
                } else if (str[i][j] == 'Y') {
                    stone[0][i][j] = 1;
                } else {
                    sci[i][j] = str[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                str2[i][j] = s.charAt(j-1);
                if (str2[i][j] >= '0' && str2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    ca[i][j] = str2[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        
        expand();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (sci[i][j] > 0) {
                    for (int a = 0; a < 12; ++a) Arrays.fill(vis[a], 0);
                    dfs(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int k = 1; k <= t; ++k) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                    for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx) {
                        for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny) {
                            dp[k][x][y][nx][ny] += dp[k-1][x][y][nx][ny];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        S = 0;
        T = n * n * 2 + 1;
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                addedge(S, (i-1)*n + j, sci[i][j]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                addedge(n*n + (i-1)*n + j, T, ca[i][j]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx) {
                    for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny) {
                        if (sci[x][y] > 0 && ca[nx][ny] > 0) {
                            if (dp[t][x][y][nx][ny] > 0) {
                                addedge((x-1)*n + y, n*n + (nx-1)*n + ny, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int ans = SAP(S, T);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
